verdict.rationale: Bruno does not expose its own API reference (the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path). However, it does let users attach docs to runnable collections: there is a Docs tab with a rich-text editor and AI-written docs, docs can be published as shareable HTML, and a README button lets anyone open a collection in Bruno to run its requests. Together these approximate an interactive API reference with runnable examples, though the evidence is thin. Missing for 10: evidence that the published HTML docs are interactive or runnable in the browser, a dedicated API-reference explorer experience, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
